scope: All source files reviewed and all public API refusal contracts indexed. Lexical sites remain candidates, not individually path-executed exceptions or a resolved Julia call graph.

grouped_contracts.trigger: Variable count outside inclusive 1..32
grouped_contracts.actionability: Reduce dimension or use a separate derivative workflow; 32 itself does not refuse.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: No public dimension/memory override; _mv_variables hard limit
grouped_contracts.units: variable count
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Supplied matrices may instead enter normal_modes(K,M); that does not compute derivatives.
notes: Check runs before symbolic Hessian allocation. Exactly 32 proceeds to dense symbolic entries and n² compiled functions. No source-derived bound on symbolic graph size or compilation RAM.

grouped_contracts.trigger: 24*8*n² > max_memory_bytes
grouped_contracts.exact_error_or_status: ArgumentError("normal_modes full dense solve n=$n estimates $estimated_bytes bytes (including workspace), exceeding max_memory_bytes=$max_memory_bytes; use a structured/partial eigensolver when only a few modes are required, or explicitly raise the budget.")
grouped_contracts.actionability: Reduce problem or explicitly raise budget after independently estimating available memory.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: PUBLIC keyword max_memory_bytes::Integer
grouped_contracts.units: bytes; matrices dimension n
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: External structured/partial eigensolver; no generic AML public partial route. ControlledModes.partial_chain is maintainer-only and chain-specific.
notes: Direct matrix refusal precedes coefficient traversal, metadata copies and dense conversion. Sparse/Diagonal inputs do not select a sparse route. Estimate excludes symbolic input graphs and metadata; not peak RSS.

grouped_contracts.trigger: Nonpositive or Bool memory budget; invalid tolerances; invalid matrix dimensions

errors: ArgumentError("max_memory_bytes must be a positive integer")
DimensionMismatch("K and M must be equal nonempty square matrices")
ArgumentError("tolerances must be finite and nonnegative")
ArgumentError("tolerances must be representable as Float64")

grouped_contracts.actionability: Supply equal nonempty square matrices, positive non-Bool integer bytes, nonnegative Float64-representable tolerances.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: PUBLIC max_memory_bytes::Integer, atol::Real, rtol::Real
grouped_contracts.units: bytes; atol in numeric coefficient/spectral scales; rtol dimensionless
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Use explicitly scaled finite real matrices and preserve physical scaling externally or through snapshot adapter.
notes: Non-integer max_memory_bytes may fail keyword type checking rather than the explicit ArgumentError.

grouped_contracts.trigger: Missing Hessian, invalid physical prerequisites, inconsistent units or shape

notes: Cartesian Hessian unavailable; no derivative or eigensolver invoked.
Finite Cartesian coordinates and positive masses required.
Coordinates, masses and Hessian must all have units or all be unitless.
Mass units must be mass or molar mass.
Incompatible coordinate, mass or Hessian units.
exact_error_or_status.shape_error: DimensionMismatch("Hessian must be Nd by Nd in particle-major order.")

grouped_contracts.actionability: Supply caller-computed particle-major Cartesian energy Hessian, finite coordinates, positive masses and compatible scales; do not infer equilibrium.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: PUBLIC hessian; kwargs forwards max_memory_bytes to matrix solve
grouped_contracts.units: n=N*d; length/mass/stiffness scales; angular frequencies sqrt(stiffness_scale/mass_scale)
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Call direct normal_modes(K,M) for a preflight before coefficient traversal; retain explicit order/scaling responsibility.
notes: Adapter traverses H and allocates scaled kn at line 41 before direct matrix budget gate; forwarded budget does not protect all upstream allocations.

grouped_contracts.operation: Real exact algebra / scalar-field domain and exact stationary search
grouped_contracts.trigger: Degree, projected coefficient bits, work or syntax node/depth budget exhausted
grouped_contracts.actionability: Use a supported simpler expression; do not present unknown as proof of no roots or recommend bounds as recovery from this budget.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: INTERNAL _RA_MAX_DEGREE/_RA_MAX_BITS/_RA_MAX_WORK plus fixed _ra_preflight; no public override
grouped_contracts.units: polynomial degree; coefficient bits; charged work units; syntax nodes/depth
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Independent external numerical reasoning with its own domain/evidence; AML bounded fallback only for unsupported exact classes with established domain, not resource exhaustion.
notes: Not a total process memory bound; excludes caller expression construction and Symbolics compilation. Scalar-field derivatives are built before this domain/exact-search budget.

grouped_contracts.trigger: Bounded Cartesian seeds exceed 50000; exact separable root products exceed 4096; invalid controls

exact_error_or_status.cartesian_error: ArgumentError("Cartesian search exceeds its resource budget")

grouped_contracts.actionability: Reduce grid/dimension or omit bounds when exact analysis is sufficient; more iterations does not override product cap.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: PUBLIC bounds/grid/iterations; product caps INTERNAL
grouped_contracts.units: seed/candidate counts and Newton iterations
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Supported exact affine-gradient or separable-polynomial class; bounded Newton only after unsupported exact class and established domain.
notes: Grid product validation occurs after derivatives, compilation and exact search, even if exact raw candidates already exist. Generic final note suggests bounds even when resource_budget/unknown_domain will not use them.

grouped_contracts.trigger: Selected pair count or estimated output bytes exceeds cap

exact_error_or_status.note: Pair output refused: N=$(length(s.positions)), pairs=$pairs_count, estimated bytes=$estimated_bytes; max_pairs=$max_pairs, max_bytes=$max_bytes. Use streaming RDF or coordination for bounded-output summaries (still quadratic work).

grouped_contracts.actionability: Use bounded-output RDF/coordination if pair list not needed, or explicitly raise pair/byte controls.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: PUBLIC max_pairs and max_bytes
grouped_contracts.units: pairs; estimated bytes
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: radial_distribution / coordination perform streaming pair traversal with bounded aggregate output, still quadratic work.
notes: Selection arrays allocated before budget comparison. Fixed width estimate is not a bound for BigFloat/backend quantities; Bool is accepted by these Integer checks unlike normal_modes.

grouped_contracts.trigger: Unbound/nonfinite/unrepresentable coefficients, asymmetry, non-SPD or numerically unresolved mass, nonfinite/underflow arithmetic

notes: Bind all parameters to finite Float64-representable real coefficients.
Stiffness matrix is not symmetric within tolerance.
Mass matrix is not symmetric within tolerance.
Mass Cholesky factorization did not establish positive definiteness.
Mass positivity/numerical rank is unresolved; singular, indefinite or numerically ill-conditioned masses are unsupported.
Mass weighting underflowed a nonzero stiffness entry.
Nonfinite spectrum.
Nonfinite eigenpair diagnostics.

grouped_contracts.actionability: Bind parameters; scale matrices sensibly and ensure symmetric K/SPD M. Do not erase negative stiffness eigenvalues: those are unstable modes with missing real frequencies, not a refusal.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: PUBLIC atol,rtol; internal Float64 rank floor
grouped_contracts.units: coefficient/spectral numerical scales; rtol dimensionless
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Use a solver supporting the actual indefinite/singular/damped problem outside this undamped SPD contract.

grouped_contracts.trigger: Equilibrium or original smooth domain not established, explicit time dependence, or nonzero damping/gyroscopic matrix

notes: Zero equilibrium EL residual was not established.
Explicit-time mechanical linearization is unsupported.
Mechanical linearization is not established on the original smooth domain.
Nonzero damping or gyroscopic matrix: undamped normal modes are unsupported.

grouped_contracts.actionability: Bind remaining parameters and establish equilibrium/smooth original domain. Damping must simplify identically to zero, not merely be below tolerance.
grouped_contracts.configurable_control: PUBLIC parameters; no damping-ignore or equilibrium-tolerance override
grouped_contracts.units: formal M,C,K coefficients and coordinate order; no inferred physical units
grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Retain formal MechanicalLinearization matrices for inspection; use a separate quadratic eigenproblem for damping.

errors: ArgumentError("between 1 and 32 states are supported")

DomainError(value,"ODE right-hand side is not representable in Float64")
DomainError(u0,"initial state must be representable in Float64")

grouped_contracts.units: state count; numeric Float64 state/time; physical units not inferred

Momentum substitution did not verify.
Energy substitution did not verify.

grouped_contracts.supported_alternative: Stay with Lagrangian equations/dynamics if valid; no implicit constrained Hamiltonian conversion.
